root_cause: The precompiled header cmake_pch.hxx.gch for the openvino_reference target is corrupted/stale or mismatched with the compiler invocation used for this translation unit, so cc1plus rejects it with 'not a PCH file'. With -Werror=invalid-pch (CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON) this becomes a hard build failure across dozens of src/core/reference object files in rapid succession, indicating the PCH itself is unusable rather than a single source-level bug. This is a known recurring infrastructure/toolchain issue on the ARM64 cross-compilation job unrelated to the PR's GPU transformation change; it has recurred 9 times since 2026-09-24, with 6 occurrences (including this one) in the last 12 hours alone, suggesting a flaky/stale sccache or PCH cache artifact reused across cross-compilation runners rather than a one-off fluke.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally; it stems from a stale/corrupted PCH artifact on the ARM64 cross-compilation CI runner/cache. To attempt reproduction: run the same cmake configure (-DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON -DENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=ON) and build openvino_reference with a pre-existing stale cmake_pch.hxx.gch from a prior incompatible compiler/toolchain version, then rebuild without regenerating the PCH.
recommended_actions: Invalidate/clear the sccache and any cached cmake_pch.hxx.gch artifacts used by the ARM64 cross-compilation build cache before the next run (bump a cache key or purge the cache).

Consider disabling precompiled headers (ENABLE_FASTER_BUILD=OFF) for the openvino_reference target on this cross-compilation job, or set -Wno-error=invalid-pch so a bad PCH triggers a rebuild instead of a hard failure.
Add a CI step to validate the PCH file (e.g., checksum or recompile-if-stale) before using it in the Build step for this workflow.
Since this is the 9th occurrence (6 in the last 12h), escalate to the CI infrastructure owners to investigate the underlying cache/runner issue rather than relying on reruns.
prevention_strategies: Key the sccache/PCH cache by compiler version + cmake flags so a toolchain change invalidates stale PCH artifacts; add a post-build sanity check that fails fast with a clear message when a PCH mismatch is detected; consider a periodic cache-clear schedule for the ARM64 cross-compilation job's build cache.
historical_context: This exact signature (cc1plus: not a PCH file, -Werror=invalid-pch) has been recorded 8 prior times in the CI Doctor MQ pattern database since 2026-09-24T23:04:41Z, most recently 2026-10-06T10:37:24Z, across many unrelated PRs (e.g. #37908, #38604, #38607, #38611, #38030, #38483, #38380, #38393, #37942), confirming it is an infrastructure/toolchain caching issue on the ARM64 cross-compilation runner rather than code introduced by this PR.
